# Kaleidoscope (kaleidoscope.dmh.dev)

> Interactive WebGL shader kaleidoscope blending fractal mirror symmetry, procedural sakura cherry blossoms, and harmonic color palettes. Part of dmh.dev by Dennis Martin Herbers.

## Features
- Real-time WebGL fragment shader rendering with four visual presets: Sakura Bloom, Prism Fractal, Lotus Mandala, and Neon Cyber.
- Adjustable mirror symmetry segments (4 to 16 folds), animation speed, floral bloom intensity, and pointer-reactive prism tilt.
- Optional glassmorphic performance HUD (FPS and frame time sparkline) and full reduced-motion support.
